title: JPMorgan Chase, Visa and Mastercard vendor breach, Nov 2026

subject.name: JPMorgan Chase
subject.about: JPMorgan Chase is a global financial services firm. Its J.P. Morgan and Chase brands serve millions of consumers, small businesses, and corporate, institutional and government clients in the US and around the world.

also_called: the Visa and Mastercard vendor breach
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by JPMorgan Chase, Visa, Mastercard, any news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: JPMorgan Chase is the largest US bank, and Visa and Mastercard run major global card networks. None has said how many customers were affected, and the companies say only marketing data and email addresses were involved, so the real reach is not known.
who_is_affected: Some JPMorgan Chase customers whose names and emails were held by its vendors, a small group of Mastercard cardholders in one benefit program, and some Visa customers in Asia Pacific. Chase says it will contact those affected. Be wary of emails about the breach.

known.text: JPMorgan Chase says vendors that provide it services were the target of a cyberattack that reached marketing data, which may include some customer names and email addresses.
Visa says the claims about its data come from an incident at a third-party service provider in Asia Pacific.
Mastercard says a third-party provider had an incident that exposed some email addresses of a small group of cardholders.
JPMorgan Chase says it will contact affected customers directly.

not_known.text: Which vendor or vendors were attacked.
Whether the three companies' cases come from the same vendor.

figures.detail: Statement reported by Reuters and ABC News
